lineage_clock_expressions.expression_sql: CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) AS BIGINT) AS contact_age_days
CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), COALESCE(CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE)) AS BIGINT) AS days_to_conversion

CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) < 30 THEN 'New Contact' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) < 90 THEN 'Recent Contact' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) < 365 THEN 'Established Contact' ELSE 'Mature Contact' END AS contact_maturity_segment

change.definition: Compare absolute row delta, pred-only/gold-only key counts, and per-column L0/L3 mismatch and unmatched-occurrence counts. Shrunk means every comparable component non-increasing and at least one smaller, with no unavailable component. No sum or causal attribution.

aggregate.summary_rule: For ambiguous dates, any matching date is counted once at the best observed level. Otherwise any strict componentwise reduction is counted as shrink; unchanged requires all dates unchanged. Individual dates remain separate; no historical date is chosen.
